symptoms.symptom: The general electrical system of the appliance is not working.

causes.label: The circuit breaker in the circuit breaker panel has tripped.
remedies: Check circuit breaker or fuse box to your house.
Make sure there is proper electrical power to the appliance. The plug for the power cord is not plugged in. ▶ Connect the appliance to the power supply. There has been a power failure.
Check whether the lighting in your kitchen or other appliances in the room are working.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "The circuit breaker in the circuit breaker panel has tripped."

symptoms.symptom: The automatic ignition is not working.

causes.label: Food remnants, dirt, or cleaning products are located between the igniters and the burners.
remedies: Clean the space between the igniter and the burner.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "Food remnants, dirt, or cleaning products are located between the igniters and the burners."

causes.label: Burner parts are wet.
remedies: Carefully dry the burner parts.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "Burner parts are wet."

causes.label: The burner parts are not positioned correctly.
remedies: Position the burner parts correctly.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "The burner parts are not positioned correctly."

causes.label: The appliance is not connected properly to the power supply.
remedies: Contact a qualified electrician.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "The appliance is not connected properly to the power supply."

symptoms.symptom: The burner flame is not uniform.

causes.label: The burner parts are not positioned correctly.
remedies: Position the burner parts correctly.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "The burner parts are not positioned correctly."

causes.label: The grooves on the burner are dirty.
remedies: Clean the grooves on the burner.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "The grooves on the burner are dirty."

symptoms.symptom: The gas flow is not normal or there is no gas.

causes.label: The gas cylinder is empty.
remedies: Replace the gas cylinder.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "The gas cylinder is empty."

symptoms.symptom: There is a smell of gas in the kitchen.

causes.label: A gas valve has been left on.
remedies: Turn off the gas taps.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "A gas valve has been left on."

causes.label: Incorrect coupling of gas cylinder.
remedies: Check the proper connection to the gas cylinder.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "Incorrect coupling of gas cylinder."

causes.label: The gas pipe to the appliance is leaking.
remedies: Shut off the gas supply at the main gas valve.
Ventilate the premises.
Immediately notify an authorised installation technician to check and certify the
installation.
Do not use the appliance until you can be sure there are no gas leaks in the gas
supply line or the appliance.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "The gas pipe to the appliance is leaking."

symptoms.symptom: The burner switches off immediately after releasing the control knob.

causes.label: The control knob has not been pressed down long enough.
remedies: Keep the control knob pressed in for a few seconds after ignition.
Push the control knob in firmly.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "The control knob has not been pressed down long enough."

symptoms.symptom: The indicator light on the control knob flashes red.

causes.label: There is an electronics fault
remedies: Disconnect the appliance from the power supply.
Wait a couple of seconds and reconnect the appliance to the power supply.
If the message persists, call Customer Support.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 26: "There is an electronics fault"
